models_evaluated: ROVER and six advanced fusion algorithms

links.outcome: Clinical term recall and error rates for medication names in ASR transcripts
links.effect: Medication names were the highest-error clinical term category for most systems; highest-error drugs misrecognized in 85% to 93% of on-device occurrences versus 3% to 30% in cloud.
links.quote: Medication names were the highest-error clinical term category for most systems in both deployment modes; the highest-error drugs were misrecognized in 85% to 93% of on-device occurrences versus 3% to 30% in the cloud.

unlisted_practices: Domain adaptation of ASR models (medical-dictation model) to reduce medication name errors
Multi-model fusion (ROVER) of ASR outputs to improve accuracy
On-device versus cloud ASR deployment to keep patient audio local

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating clinical speech recognition models across cloud and on-device architectures on transcription accuracy and failure modes (specifically medication names).
